name: Acmer S2 Pro 36W
tagline: Acmer S2 Pro mid-power — enclosed-optional 36W tier
tldr: Acmer S2 Pro 36W is the lower-power SKU on Acmer's S2 Pro line with rotary and IR bundle options. Compare to S2 Pro 48W before buying — often worth the step up.
mainObjective: Maximum cut speed and depth in the line — engraving remains strong at tuned speeds

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cannot: 48W tier exists for more cut depth

pros: Acmer S2 Pro mid-power — enclosed-optional 36W tier
Fully enclosed cabinet — beam containment and smoke control vs open-frame diodes
Work area 400 × 400 mm on this chassis
Best cut headroom in the line — benchmarked around 8 mm basswood-class stock
36W: the most cut-focused head in the Acmer S2 Pro line
Reference engrave job on this module: ~14–22 min
cons: Ultra-fine photo engraving may need slower settings than a 10W engraving-first module
Still a diode — clear acrylic production wants CO₂
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 36W module on Acmer S2 Pro. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Treat engraving and cutting as separate profiles. Push cut speeds only after test squares on your material. Compare CO₂ only when clear acrylic or all-day production enters the picture.
